title: First-time Adoption of Indian Accounting Standards
summary: Governs the first-time adoption of Indian Accounting Standards by entities transitioning from previous Indian GAAP, converged with IFRS 1 with specific Indian carve-outs/carve-ins reflecting the regulatory and legal context.

bannerNotice.title: Ind AS — Converged with, but Not Identical to, IFRS
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 101 is India's national standard, issued by the MCA (Ministry of Corporate Affairs) under the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, converged with IFRS 1 but containing SPECIFIC CARVE-OUTS/CARVE-INS reflecting Indian regulatory and legal context. Section 11 below details every material difference from IFRS 1.
